rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone or something that is young or has a young quality.

example.english: Although this is an old film, the leading actress still looks youthful.
example.traditional: 呢套戲雖然係舊戲，但個女主角睇落仲好年輕。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 seoi1 jin4 hai6 gau6 hei3 daan6 go3 neoi5 zyu2 gok3 tai2 lok6 zung6 hou2 nin4 heng1

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice especially when saying that a person is young or looks young.

example.english: You look so youthful that no one would believe you have a son.
example.traditional: 你個樣咁後生，話你有個仔真係冇人信。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 joeng2 gam3 hau6 saang1 waa6 nei5 jau5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 seon3

rows.note: Use this when youthful describes lively energy or a fresh, vigorous manner rather than age itself.

example.english: After exercising in the morning, I feel youthful and full of energy.
example.traditional: 朝早做完運動，我成個人都好有朝氣。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 ngo5 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 hou2 jau5 ziu1 hei3
